# sanparks-watch: the priority set
#
# The 223 archived frames Jeremy sorted as WORTH DETECTING on 7 September 2026,
# from the annotated review of all 524 confirmed-animal frames. The rest went
# into "Birds or not visible": small birds and frames where nothing is legible.
# Format: <cam>/<YYYYMMDD>/<HHMMSS>   (HHMMSS is UTC, the join key)
#
# WHAT IT IS FOR. tools/ground_truth.txt says "an animal is in this frame".
# This file says "and losing it would matter". Recall against ground_truth was
# always the wrong target at Nossob, where two thirds of the confirmed animals
# are birds Jeremy has stated he accepts losing. Recall against THIS set is the
# target.
#
# HIS WORDS, 7 SEPTEMBER: the "Birds or not visible" frames are ones we can
# accept to lose, which does not mean we have to lose them.
#
# Split: nossob 174, talamati 35, satara 14.
#
